name: chat-timeline
title: Chat timeline
description: Presentational conversation log over a session's turns (ADR 0197): the person's messages with their attachments and, on hover or a tap, when each was sent, inbound messages and task notifications (ADR 0217), each reply under the timed steps that led to it (notes fold into the answer's steps once a turn settles), copy, fork and Restore to here, notices, handoffs, answered questions, failures with retry, reconnect and auto-retry, interruptions, pending sends, the editable queue, the live activity line (the running turn's clock and silence sit on its latest steps line), and stick-to-bottom scrolling. Stateless: feed it from useAgentChat. Used by agent-chat.
docs:
Install the five files together in one directory with chat-queue and edge-fade beside them; keep their relative imports. Render ChatTimeline from useAgentChat: timeline, pending, queue, activity, requests (chat.state?.requests), hasOlder, isLoadingOlder and onLoadOlder, plus the actions you support (onEditQueued, onCancelQueued, onSendQueuedNow, onHoldQueued, onRetry, onInterrupt, onRollback, onFork, onResendFailed, onDismissFailed). Each control shows only when its callback is given. activeTurnId and the activity clock default to the timeline's active turn.

Styles: the components use Tailwind utilities with the Catamorphic theme tokens (bg, fg, border, accent, info, danger, success). Import @catamorphic/ui/styles.css from your Tailwind entry: it carries .cat-markdown and the timeline's motion classes (cat-fade-in, cat-fold-away, cat-step-in, cat-gap-in, cat-swap-out and cat-swap-in with the cat-swap-slot that slides what follows a changing label, cat-reveal and cat-grow, with a reduced-motion rule), the scroll pinning that keeps the latest message still (cat-scroll-anchor under data-pinned), cat-edge-fade, which fades the conversation where it continues past an edge, and cat-settled, which skips settled turns out of view. Without it the states still change, unanimated. Focus follows a global :focus-visible ring the host provides; the timeline draws only the outline of a deep-linked message.

Host slots: renderAttachment(attachment, place) draws a sent attachment inline in the words or in the strip above them (default: a pill with an icon and the name, data-testid sent-pill). Hint ({ label, shortcut?, children }) names each control on hover (default: the native title). renderLink and onLinkClick route Markdown links (session:, run:, workflow:, file: and other host schemes survive sanitizing only with onLinkClick). sourceHref addresses where an inbound message or notification came from. resolveToolIcon gives connector tools their icons, onFileClick opens edited files, onReauth (with reauthLabel) reconnects an account after an auth failure, backgroundCommands lets background steps say whether their process still runs, workDisplay chooses how notes read (see turn-rows.ts), and registerJumpToPreviousUserMessage hands a composer shortcut the move to the previous message (no button draws it).

Keep render-affecting slots stable (memoized callbacks or module-level components): rows are memoized and re-render when a slot's identity changes. Action callbacks may change every render; the timeline always calls the latest.
